<details>
The provided `.SRCINFO` file is a metadata file used by Arch Linux's AUR to describe the package build configuration. It declares standard fields such as package name, description, version, dependencies, and source location. The source points to a Git repository hosted on Codeberg (`https://codeberg.org/kosmonaut/kosmonaut.git`), which is consistent with the project's stated upstream. The `sha256sums = SKIP` entry is expected for VCS (Git) packages in AUR, as the checksum cannot be known in advance due to the mutable nature of the repository. This practice is normal and not inherently unsafe.

There are no commands, scripts, or executable content in this file. It does not perform any network operations, file modifications, or system calls. It solely serves as declarative metadata for the PKGBUILD and associated tools like `makepkg`. No obfuscated code, suspicious URLs, or unauthorized data exfiltration mechanisms are present.

The package depends only on `networkmanager`, `git`, and `rust`, all of which are legitimate and expected for a Rust-based TUI application interfacing with NetworkManager. The `provides` and `conflicts` fields correctly indicate it replaces the non-git `kosmonaut` package. All entries align with standard AUR packaging practices.
</details>
